forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: No material new evidence in last 3 days; Anthropic CEO continues to project AGI ~2027 while Hassabis maintains ~50% by 2030. Holding steady.
forecasts.base_rate: Reference class: AI capability transitions that experts predicted within 5 years have historically materialized ~25-35% of the time within original timeframe. Adjusting for unprecedented current pace.

factors_up.factor: Anthropic Opus 4.6 / 4.7 releases show continued capability gains
Major lab CEOs (Amodei) publicly forecasting AGI in 2027
Massive capex flowing in ($122B OpenAI round at $852B valuation)

factors_down.factor: Definitional ambiguity — '3+ leading researchers' standard is high bar
Historical pattern of AI timelines slipping
Hassabis (DeepMind) more cautious view dominates measured consensus

key_uncertainties: What counts as a 'credible' AGI announcement vs. marketing
Whether scaling laws continue to hold past current frontier
Compute/energy constraints emerging in 2027-2029
update_triggers: Major lab formal AGI declaration
Open letter from 3+ named researchers asserting AGI achieved
Sustained benchmark plateau lasting >9 months

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: Slight downgrade: latest data shows BCG AI revenue at $3.6B (25% of total) and Bain projecting AI to be 50% of consulting — AI substituting for some roles but expanding revenue base.
forecasts.base_rate: Industry-wide 33%+ revenue declines over 5-year periods are rare (<15% of professional services industries historically). Job declines of that magnitude have occurred in disrupted sectors (~25% base rate).

factors_up.factor: McKinsey shrunk from 45k to 40k staff with another 10% cut announced Dec 2025
Entry-level analyst roles being squeezed materially
Client willingness-to-pay declining for AI-replaceable work

factors_down.factor: BCG/Bain growing AI revenue offsets analyst displacement
Firms repositioning as AI implementation partners — net revenue up
Definition of 'consultancy' likely to shift faster than measurement

key_uncertainties: Whether the '33% decline' would be measured at headcount or revenue
How analyst credentialing/training pipelines respond to AI substitution
Speed of client adoption of in-house AI replacing external advisory
update_triggers: Major firm announcing >20% workforce cut in a single year
Industry revenue contraction reported by Source Global Research / Kennedy
Big 3 firm winding down advisory practice area

forecasts.question: Will Labour be largest party at next UK General Election?
forecasts.key_change: Small upward revision: ongoing Labour leadership crisis with Burnham as preferred successor (members 74% think Labour wins under Burnham vs 28% under Starmer) creates a path to recovery, though Reform's 7-point lead remains structurally hard to overturn.
forecasts.base_rate: Parties trailing by 8+ points 3 years before election win largest seat share ~15-20% of the time historically; current FPTP fragmentation makes seat conversion harder for Labour than headline polling suggests.

factors_up.factor: Possible Burnham leadership transition could re-energise Labour vote
Reform polling has declined from 34% peak to ~25%
3.5 years remaining — long horizon for political volatility

factors_down.factor: Reform UK leading at 26.9% nationally and projected 188 seats
Labour at just 18.7% national share and projected only 86 seats
Green surge (15.1%, 71 seats) splits progressive vote
Starmer net favourability -57, among worst PM ratings on record

key_uncertainties: Whether Labour replaces Starmer before 2027 and with whom
Whether Reform's coalition holds or fragments
Whether progressive vote consolidates back to Labour vs. Greens
update_triggers: Starmer resignation or leadership challenge succeeds
Sustained Labour polling above 25%
Reform-Conservative pact / merger announcement

forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2035?
forecasts.key_change: No change since last forecast. Long horizon (9.5 years) accommodates multiple capability transitions; majority of researcher surveys cluster around 2030-2035.
forecasts.base_rate: Aggregated AI researcher surveys (AI Impacts, Metaculus) median estimates for HLMI cluster 2032-2040; conditional on continued scaling, P(AGI before 2035) ~70-85%.

factors_up.factor: Capital investment levels (>$500B/year by 2026) unprecedented
Multiple labs at similar capability frontier accelerates progress
Researcher consensus shifting earlier vs 2-3 years ago

factors_down.factor: Definitional gating ('3+ leading researchers') may delay recognition
Possible compute/energy/data wall before 2035
Regulatory or geopolitical disruption could pause deployment

key_uncertainties: Whether scaling laws extend to 2030+
Whether algorithmic breakthroughs needed and arrive in time
Resolution criteria interpretation for 'AGI achieved'
update_triggers: Sustained capability plateau >18 months
Major lab AGI declaration
Compute supply chain disruption

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: Holding steady. US 2026 Annual Threat Assessment confirms Chinese leadership has no fixed invasion timeline; PLA conducting more frequent show-of-force exercises but no escalatory threshold crossed.
forecasts.base_rate: Major-power military invasions of contested territories: ~3-7% per 5-year window in modern era; Taiwan-specific elevated by capability buildup but suppressed by costs.

factors_up.factor: PLA naval/coast guard surge: 100+ vessels around Taiwan recently
Continued PLA modernization on track for 2027 capability targets
Strategic windows narrowing as Taiwan defense improves

factors_down.factor: US IC: Chinese leadership not committed to 2027 invasion
Amphibious operations remain extraordinarily difficult
CCP regime political risks of failed operation very high
2049 unification target gives flexibility

key_uncertainties: Whether escalation via blockade reaches 72-hour threshold
How a Taiwan independence-leaning election outcome affects calculus
Whether economic pressure substitutes for military action
update_triggers: PLA mobilization of multiple group armies near coast
Significant blockade-level exercise lasting >48 hours
Taiwan declaration of independence or constitutional change

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: Material downgrade: BoE April 2026 MPR now projects CPI rising to 3.1% Q2, 3.3% Q3 and 'somewhat further in Q4' due to Middle East conflict and energy prices. April 2026 print was 2.8%. Path to sub-2% in 2026 essentially closed.
forecasts.base_rate: Conditional on central bank forecasts above 3% for remainder of year, probability of any month printing below 2% within 7 months historically <10%.

factors_up.factor: April 2026 CPI surprise to downside (2.8% vs 3.0% expected)
Energy price cap on 1 April 2026 dragging headline lower
Possible sharp commodity reversal if Middle East de-escalates

factors_down.factor: BoE projecting inflation rising back to ~3.5% by end-2026
Services inflation persistence above 4%
Middle East energy supply risks ongoing

key_uncertainties: Whether oil/gas prices spike further or reverse
Wage growth persistence in services
Speed of energy price cap pass-through to CPI
update_triggers: Single monthly CPI print at or below 2.2%
Middle East ceasefire and oil price collapse
BoE pivoting to expect inflation back to target in 2026

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Marginal trim from 98 to 97. Tracking remains exceptional (1B+ trailer views, Polymarket 54.5% to be top-grossing of 2026, $340M+ international opening predecessor). Five months from July 31 release to Dec 31 deadline provides comfortable runway.
forecasts.base_rate: Of Spider-Man MCU films, 3/3 prior releases crossed $1B; comparable Marvel tentpoles with this buzz crossed $1.5B in ~70-80% of cases.

factors_up.factor: Trailer crossed 1B views in under a week — record-setting
5-month theatrical window before resolution deadline
Polymarket implied 54.5% to be #1 of 2026
No Way Home grossed $1.92B as benchmark

factors_down.factor: Theatrical/streaming substitution continues to erode tails
Tariff / China release uncertainty
Possible quality misfire risk

key_uncertainties: China release approval and box office contribution
Critical reception and word-of-mouth
Competition from Avengers: Doomsday spillover
update_triggers: Opening weekend < $200M domestic
Rotten Tomatoes score below 75%
Studio China release blocked

forecasts.question: Will OpenAI and Anthropic have a combined ARR exceeding $70B by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Threshold already cleared in current reporting: Anthropic at ~$45B ARR, OpenAI at ~$33B = ~$78B combined as of May 2026. Only material risk is dramatic accounting revision or business shock.
forecasts.base_rate: Conditional on having already exceeded the threshold mid-year, probability of holding above by year-end historically ~99% absent catastrophic event.

factors_up.factor: Combined ARR already ~$78B per most recent reporting
Superforecaster consensus $160B-$240B by year-end
Q4 2026 has seasonal enterprise upsell tailwind

factors_down.factor: OpenAI accounting dispute (gross vs net) could trim reported figures
Catastrophic regulatory action conceivable but unlikely
Possible Q4 deceleration if frontier model launches slip

key_uncertainties: Which accounting convention 'credible reporting' adopts
Whether either company restates ARR downward
Macro shock affecting enterprise spending
update_triggers: Major published restatement reducing ARR by >$15B
Regulatory shutdown action against either firm
Q3 2026 ARR reporting showing decline

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: No change. OBR March 2026 EFO has growth averaging 1.6% out to 2030-31; question requires sustaining 1.5% average for full decade including 2032-2039 where forecasts have higher uncertainty.
forecasts.base_rate: UK 10-year rolling real GDP growth averages have exceeded 1.5% in roughly 50% of decades since 1990; trend growth post-2008 has been ~1.3% making 1.5% an above-trend ask.

factors_up.factor: OBR projecting 1.6% growth through 2030-31
AI productivity upside if it materializes mid-decade
Investment recovery from planning reforms

factors_down.factor: Post-2008 trend growth has been below 1.5%
Demographics: working-age population growth slowing
Productivity forecasting historically over-optimistic
Geopolitical/energy risk premiums elevated

key_uncertainties: Whether AI delivers measurable productivity gains in macro stats
Net migration policy and labour supply
Whether at least one recession reduces decade average
update_triggers: OBR materially revising trend growth assumption
Sustained productivity print >1% per worker for 2+ years
Major UK recession in early 2030s
